about.heading: About Us
body: North Wales Lawn Care is a locally owned and operated garden maintenance business serving homes and commercial properties across Conwy, Gwynedd, Anglesey, and Denbighshire. Founded with a genuine passion for the outdoors, we take pride in delivering reliable, high-quality lawn care and gardening services at honest prices.

Whether you need a regular mowing schedule or a one-off garden transformation, our friendly team is here to help. We treat every garden as if it were our own, and we are fully insured for your peace of mind. Get in touch today for a free, no-obligation quote.
